kpmae01.title: Mars trains Aries for one ask
kpmae01.caption:
Mars fell through the gym ceiling to coach exactly one sentence.
Eye contact reps, a mirror, a talk card, one near-disaster on the climbing wall. Stay for the answer. Who in your life needs Coach Mars?

kpmae02.title: Four months of maybe
kpmae02.caption:
Four months of hanging out and nobody has said what it is.
Going slow is fine. Say what you want in one honest sentence, at your own pace. Save this for the talk you keep putting off.

kpmae03.title: Fourteen drafts, one send
kpmae03.caption:
Fourteen drafts of hello. Mars deleted thirteen of them.
The one that got sent was about noodles. How many drafts deep is your Gemini right now?

kpmae04.title: You can go first
kpmae04.caption:
Waiting for them to make the first move so it can't hurt.
Going first is allowed. A no is information, not a verdict on you. Try it gently: I'd love to see you again, no pressure.

kpmae05.title: The 40-step ask
kpmae05.caption:
Leo planned a choir, a balloon arch and a 14-minute slideshow to ask one question.
Mars edited it down to three words. Pisces still showed up as the choir. Tag the Leo with a plan.

kpmae06.title: The spreadsheet can't ask
kpmae06.caption:
Three weeks of rows and columns about one person, and the total still says error.
You'll never have all the data. Ask one small, clear question and let their answer be the data.

kpmae07.title: Your eyes already voted
kpmae07.caption:
Libra ran a whole poll on who to talk to at the party.
Mars had one question: who do you keep looking at? The window person, every single time. Comment your Libra's poll results.

kpmae08.title: Say it warm
kpmae08.caption:
Three days of icy silence after they forgot the plans.
The hurt is allowed. Silence just makes them guess, so say it out loud and warm: I felt hurt when this happened. Can we talk?

kpmae09.title: Sometime is not a day
kpmae09.caption:
Four times Sagittarius said we should hang out sometime. Zero Saturdays.
Then a calendar the size of a door showed up. Which friend owes you a sometime?

kpmae10.title: Love isn't a Q3 goal
kpmae10.caption:
Love got scheduled for next year, if there's time.
You can't schedule the feeling, but you can make room for it. Block one free evening a week, and actually keep it.

kpmae11.title: Label it, nerd
kpmae11.caption:
Same hoodie, inside jokes, 4 a.m. chats, and Aquarius says they don't do labels.
The label maker said otherwise. Is your Aquarius just vibes, or do they like you?

kpmae12.title: Have you said hi?
kpmae12.caption:
A whole wedding planned with the person at the bus stop. A dog too. Zero words exchanged.
Daydreams are lovely, but one real hi beats a hundred of them. Start with hi.
